display_name: 源域整体相位与复增益误差诊断
description: 比较原始输入、自适应滤波、双域和 DURA 的源域逐记录最优相位和复增益校正误差，不部署源真值。

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

permissions.claim_scope: Source-only per-record clean-IQ oracle alignment, not deployable or identity accuracy

checkpoint.initialization: Fixed original DURA, independently trained adaptive inverse and dual-domain source checkpoints
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Each fixed source-only checkpoint verified by its loader; no selection or target training
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Original source-only DURA and same-contract source-only candidate, subject to completion check
checkpoint.selection_rule: Prespecified candidate final epoch5; no target score selection

expected_artifacts: result.json four source models x unaligned, oracle phase, oracle complex gain

metric_names: oracle phase and complex gain correction

rows.method: Four fixed input/output methods; per-record minimum phase-only and unconstrained complex gain source IQ errors
rows.purpose: Measure which source waveform errors can be explained by one global phase or gain
rows.seed_notes: Existing pretrained source runs and fixed source pilots; no stochastic training, support or augmentation in this benchmark.

notes: Oracle uses same-record clean source IQ; it is not available for target inference and not a trained model.
Previously explored source pilot, not independent of original DURA; no TX, F, V, target or model updates.
Oracle complex gain is an upper-bound reference within the scalar-gain family only, not a bound on all restorers or identity accuracy.
